title: Cheech and Chong's Next Movie VHS Sealed - Slight Rip - See Pics
descriptionText: The product is a sealed VHS tape of Cheech and Chong's Next Movie from 1990. This cult classic comedy film starring Cheech Marin falls under the stoner sub-genre and has a full screen edition. With an R rating, this NTSC standard VHS includes special features and is in English. Made by Universal Studios in the United States, this VHS tape is a must-have for fans of Cheech and Chong's comedic style.
